review_comments_data.body:
I think this socketPath may be wrong.

If we're not on `Heroku`, the browser may be connecting to server other than `localhost`.  So, on a network without an Internet connection one PC will be hosting Serge, and other network PCs will connect to it.

So, I think the hostname needs to come from the `window.location` 

`localhost` only works for us devs.
review_comments_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -128,7 +130,7 @@ export const hiddenPrefix = '_#_'
 
 export const clearAll = 'clearAll'
 export const allDbs = 'allDbs'
-export const socketPath = 'http://localhost:4000'
+export const socketPath = hostname.toLowerCase().indexOf('herokuapp') !== -1 ? `https://${hostname}` : 'http://localhost:4000'

issues.title: Cloudant instance not pinging for updates
issues.body:
I'm running `Serge` in `Serge-Review` heroku branch.

But, I think the `listen for changes` functionality isn't working.

The Network tab shows these failed calls:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/159730450-a0e177fd-840a-4193-9820-0c9d1e6ea421.png)

Expanding a call gives this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/159730530-c771b6ed-e90f-418f-9f3c-fa8dc21420eb.png)

It _looks_ like we're trying to call `localhost:4000` - when we should actually be calling `serge-review` (I think).
